name: Bajaj Housing Finance Ltd
title: Bajaj Housing Finance Ltd - 544252 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Bajaj Housing Q4 FY26: AUM up 23% and opex/NTI 19.2%, but spreads fell 10 bps to 1.7% and management guided ROA compression of ~10 bps in FY27 with no Q1 guidance yet.

triggers.label: Spread down 10 bps to 1.7%
triggers.quote: Gross spreads overall have moderated by 10 bps to 1.7% in Q4 FY26

triggers.label: Q4 yield compression from competition
triggers.quote: Q4 is normally a high competitive intensity market and the yields , the acquisition prices come down

triggers.label: FY27 ROA compression ~10 bps
triggers.quote: ROA compression of around 10 bps. But that will depend

triggers.label: BT-out to PSU banks persists
triggers.quote: BT-out rates have not declined from what they were in Q3

guidance.quote: which we have put out at 21% to 23%
It should be towards the upper end of the medium term guidance may not beat that.

guidance.value: INR600 crores plus over next 12 months
guidance.quote: business is well on track to achieve INR600 crores plus of a monthly disbursement over next 12 months

prior_guidance_check.quote: Company managed NIM moderation to 7 bps as against our initial assessment of 15 to 20 bps
GNPA remaining at 27 bps and NNPA at 11 bps against 35 to 40 bps and 15 bps to 20 bps

red_flags.label: Spread compression with no Q1 guidance
red_flags.quote: we'll wait for quarter 1 results to come

red_flags.label: Stage 2 PCR raised as prudence
red_flags.quote: Purely from a prudence point of view from the current market current macro environment

evasions.topic: Q1 FY27 margin and yield guidance
evasions.quote: we'll wait for quarter 1 results to come

evasions.topic: Mix of Sambhav near prime vs affordable
evasions.quote: I'll come back to you, Viral. I don't want to give you a wrong number.
